catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: Products, their varieties and SKUs, in English and Arabic.
catalogue.newProductHint: Choose the type first — it decides which details are needed. Varieties, SKUs and prices come next.
catalogue.shelfLifeHint: In months. Pre-fills the expiry date when goods are received; it can still be changed there.
catalogue.skusHint: One per pack size and packaging. The code is generated and can be overridden.
catalogue.addVarietyFirst: Add a variety first, then its SKUs.
catalogue.varietiesHint: Each variety is named in English and Arabic.
catalogue.basePriceHint: Applies to every store without its own price list.
catalogue.codeGeneratedHint: Generated from product, variety and pack size. Type to override.
catalogue.codeOverriddenHint: Your code will be kept as entered.

structure.title: Categories
structure.subtitle: The category and sub-category structure the catalogue is organised by.
structure.expiryWarningHint: Leave blank to use the system default.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.subtitle: Suppliers Green Agro buys from. Products name them by vendor code.
vendors.codeHint: Your own code, e.g. VEN-7K4M. It cannot be changed later.
vendors.codeFixed: Products name the vendor by this code, so it cannot change.
vendors.name: Vendor name

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Price lists and discount ceilings. Prices are per pack of each SKU.
pricing.priceListsHint: The base list applies to every store; an additional list overrides it for the stores assigned to it.
pricing.baseHint: Applies to every store that has no additional list.
pricing.additionalHint: Overrides the base price for the SKUs it lists. A blank price leaves the base price in place.
pricing.searchSkus: Filter by code, product or variety
pricing.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
pricing.ceilingsHint: Where the order ceiling and an item ceiling both apply, the tighter one governs. Above a ceiling, the seller asks a manager to approve.
pricing.orderCeilingHint: The most discount across a whole order.
pricing.itemCeilingHint: For every SKU without its own ceiling.
pricing.absoluteMaximumHint: Above this, approval cannot even be requested.
pricing.approvalExpiryHint: The seller waits at the store meanwhile.
pricing.skuCeilingsHint: SKUs with a ceiling of their own, instead of the item ceiling.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System-wide values and switches. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.generalHint: Rules the whole team works to.

returns.uncleared_payment_allowed: Allow returns while payment has not cleared

expiry.warning_days: Expiry warning, unless the category sets its own (days)
expiry.rate_basis: Rate of sale behind the expiry flag

stores.duplicate_radius_m: Warn about a store this close (metres)

attendance.restricted_check_in: Check-in only inside the set zone, unless a manager authorises it.

inventory.seller_conversion: Sellers granted the permission may repackage stock in the field.

settings.commissionHint: Commission is paid on cash collected, not on sales recorded.

incoming.title: Incoming stock
incoming.subtitle: Ordered and on its way. Not counted as stock until it is received.

flags.GAP_FROM_PREVIOUS: Far from the vehicle's last reading
